an4.189:1.1: Cattāro 'me bhikkhave sacchikaraṇīyā dhammā. Katame cattāro? Atthi bhikkhave dhammā kāyena sacchikaraṇīyā, atthi bhikkhave dhammā satiyā sacchikaraṇīyā, atthi bhikkhave dhammā cakkhunā sacchikaraṇīyā, atthi bhikkhave dhammā paññāya sacchikaraṇīyā. Katame ca bhikkhave dhammā kāyena sacchikaraṇīyā? Aṭṭha vimokhā bhikkhave kāyena sacchikaraṇīyā.
an4.189:2.1: Katame ca bhikkhave dhammā satiyā sacchikaraṇīyā? Pubbenivāso bhikkhave satiyā sacchikaraṇīyo.
an4.189:3.1: Katame ca bhikkhave dhammā cakkhunā sacchikaraṇīyā? Sattānaṃ cutuppāto bhikkhave cakkhunā sacchikaraṇīyo.
an4.189:4.1: Katame ca bhikkhave dhammā paññāya sacchikaranīyā? Āsavānaṃ khayo bhikkhave paññāya sacchikaraṇīyo. Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro sacchikaraṇīyā dhammā ti.
